evals.prompt: 一个400项的正式API实验在286项时因为额度停止。我已经充值，请从检查点继续，成功和失败都不能重试，完成后自动分析，但实验指南必须等我确认才能更新。
evals.expected_output: Resume in Record mode from immutable terminal records, distinguish called failures from uncalled attempts, arrange analysis and completion audit, update the package log, and only report the proposed Guide impact.
expectations: Uses Record mode and does not edit the Guide without authorization
Preserves all 286 terminal records and calls only previously uncalled Attempt IDs
Separates provider-limit procedural status from the scientific result
Requires analysis and a completion audit before marking the package complete

evals.prompt: 给一个新项目设计实验编号和目录。项目有模型准备、数据生成、外部干预和内部表征四个阶段，每项实验还会有不同模型路线和100次重复。不要把模型名和日期塞进实验编号。
evals.expected_output: Define a stable stage–domain–task Experiment ID scheme, keep route/model/replicate in lower-level identifiers, and scaffold frozen inputs, code, outputs, analysis, logs, and audits.
expectations: Defines the P0–P3 stage legend or an equally explicit project-specific legend
Separates Experiment ID, design version, Attempt ID, run version, and analysis version
Includes frozen inputs, immutable outputs, failure ledger, run manifest, analysis, and completion audit
Avoids final/latest/new naming and silent overwrite

evals.prompt: 根据已经完成的四类benchmark更新实验指南。每类都有baseline、完整方案、实证参照和若干SI消融。指南要短、能直接指导正文和附录修改，不要写HTTP调用流水账，也不要每段都重复Strength/Meaning/Boundary。
evals.expected_output: Use Synthesis mode to organize a concise research-question-first guide with comparable result tables, interpretable definitions and units, main findings in the core sections, ablations in SI, and traceable Experiment IDs.
expectations: Organizes the Guide by research question and comparable experiment paths rather than chronology
Uses compact tables for baseline, complete treatment or blueprint, and empirical reference
Moves routine execution details and non-leading ablations out of the main narrative
States interpretable conclusions instead of mechanical evidence-label boilerplate
